description: Algoma , New York, NY | Seed Algoma is revolutionizing multi-family housing development through automated design and planning software. By replacing much of the work traditionally done by design architects, Algoma is helping developers accelerate projects while reducing expenses — a crucial innovation as the construction industry continues to grow.

Arvist has developed an innovative approach to supply chain visibility that leverages existing security camera infrastructure combined with digital technology and AI. This solution provides real-time operational insights without requiring additional hardware investment, enabling businesses to optimize productivity, enhance safety protocols and improve incident response times.

Autolane , Palo Alto, CA | Seed Autolane is a curbside operating system that orchestrates autonomous vehicle arrivals, departures, pickups and deliveries in commercial parking lots. The platform combines edge IoT hardware with cloud-based software and APIs that authenticate vehicles, coordinate curb space allocation, automate trunk access and manage multiple AV fleets simultaneously.

Celerity Enterprises , Kansas City, MO | Seed A SaaS platform facilitating real-time reconciliation of rebates between manufacturers, distributors and rep agents, Celerity is poised to disrupt the $8B wholesale distribution industry. Its technology increases speed and reduces redundancies in the rebate process while ensuring integrity of the transactions between all parties.

Utilizing innovative technology, ODIN Space maps and analyzes lethal, non-trackable space debris that can cause satellite failures instantly. Their space safety platform delivers mission-critical insights to help satellite operators, insurers and investors evaluate their collision risk, identify emerging threats, maneuver when necessary and use nano sensors to analyze collisions in real time.

PLOT , Wichita, KS | Seed Built for those who have spent their career working in the field, not behind a desk, PLOT is a digital solution coordinating who and what goes where and when, eliminating jobsite chaos. Its SaaS platform is streamlining logistics, delivery and project management at construction sites for a growing client base.

A purpose-built, intuitive, cloud-based SaaS operating system, Renterra allows heavy equipment rental companies to streamline all aspects of their businesses. From managing inventory, customers, contracts, billing, maintenance and accounting to turning equipment inventory into a powerful eCommerce storefront, this all-in-one platform ensures a streamlined, efficient customer experience.

Stargazr , Santa Monica, CA | Seed Stargazr is an AI-powered platform transforming financial operations and optimizing decision-making for industrial manufacturers. The company’s software unifies real-time EBIT simulation, margin optimization and actionable operational insights, empowering finance teams to forecast with unprecedented accuracy.

SysGit , Los Angeles, CA | Seed SysGit is an augmentation software designed to help engineers easily manage and organize requirements, verification events, and other engineering data products. By activating agile hardware development, SysGit enables the timely acquistion of vehicles and weapon systems, integrating decisions across the dozens of distributed vendors supporting a single program.

Thumbprint Furniture , Falls Church, VA | Pre-seed An AI-fueled platform connecting commercial furniture manufacturers with buyers, Thumbprint simplifies the commercial furniture design and specification process by automatically generating fully specified furniture packages. The platform offers a specification generator, layout generator and document manager, streamlining the A&D process.

A rewards platform designed for the construction industry, Whistle is tackling the critical challenge of employee satisfaction and retention in construction. Leveraging digital wallet technology and a sophisticated system of rewards, recognition and AI-powered behavioral insights, Whistle is improving safety outcomes, compliance and performance on the job site.

With a keen focus on manufacturing and logistics, Wilya is helping companies transform the way they manage their factory workforce. Its software solution enables factories to unlock new talent pools, streamline hiring and shift scheduling, build a cross-skilled, flexible workforce, and increase output, delivering significant cost savings in recruitment, retention and overtime costs.

Zuum , Irvine, CA | Seed+ An integrated freight solution, Zuum’s platform connects shippers and carriers with a robust mobile application catering to drivers. Built to scale and instantly ready to use, its integrated digital workflows automate freight and link ERP on one super platform while offering dedicated tools for brokers.
